environment.description: Ktor service deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (10.0.2.0/24). The subnet route table (rtb-0priv2nonat) has only a local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a route to the VPC endpoint for ECR (vpce-0ecr). There is no NAT gateway, internet gateway route, or VPC peering to any internet-connected VPC. The LDAP server is accessible via a VPC endpoint interface (vpce-0ldap, ENI in 10.0.2.0/24). Security group sg-0def456 on the Fargate tasks permits egress ONLY to sg-0ldap789 on port 389 and to the pl-0ecr prefix list on 443. DNS resolution is handled by Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The task execution role has no permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents. CloudWatch agent sidecar captures all stdout/stderr but ships only to the local region log group with a resource policy restricting cross-account access.

config.security_group_tasks: sg-0def456: egress tcp/389 to sg-0ldap789 only, egress tcp/443 to pl-0ecr only, ingress tcp/8080 from sg-0alb-internal
config.security_group_ldap: sg-0ldap789: ingress tcp/389 from sg-0def456 only
config.dns: Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint, no external forwarding rules
config.network_acl: nacl-0priv2: allow tcp/389 to 10.0.2.200, allow tcp/443 to pl-0ecr, deny all other outbound
